BillHeading.Sponsors: Representatives Scott, Taylor, Condotta, and Sawyer

BillHistory.ReferredCommittee: Referred to Committee on State Government.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to implementation of year-round Pacific Standard Time; adding a new section to chapter 1.20 RCW; and repealing RCW 1.20.051.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. A new section is added to chapter 1.20 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: The time of the state of Washington shall be Pacific Standard Time throughout the calendar year, as determined by reference to Greenwich Mean Time.

BillSectionHeader.P: RCW 1.20.051 (Daylight saving time) and 1963 c 14 s 1 & 1961 c 3 s 1 are each repealed.
